ILLUSTRATIVE. The audit reports this file's aggregate shape (68 REACTION
blocks, each product sourced PLANT_MAT:species:part, fixed and non-
parametric) and a count, never a single literal example line, so nothing
below is a verbatim quote. Included only to give the extractor a second
wholly-fixed product case from a different mechanism (PLANT_MAT rather
than METAL) and to keep the fixture set naming all four shipped reaction
files, per the handoff's minimum.
